summary: Completed frontend testing of German hero section bugfix. The IdentityHero component now correctly displays a two-column layout with text on the LEFT and animated scene on the RIGHT at desktop viewport. All animated elements (aurora, grid, particles, route line, pulsing badge) are present and functional. Responsive behavior works correctly, stacking vertically at mobile widths (<=860px). NL and FR locales could not be tested as those pages are not available in the current preview build.
passed_tests: German hero section displays two-column layout: text LEFT, scene RIGHT at desktop (1920x1080)
Grid layout uses correct column proportions (578px / 707px ≈ 0.9fr / 1.1fr)
'Live Vorschau' badge visible in top-left of scene with pulsing dot animation
Pascal character contained within right column at 46% width (not full-width)
All three characters present and positioned correctly: Pascal (center), NeX (left), AI Fly Oracle (right)
Two CTA buttons visible in left text column: 'Vorhaben planen' and 'Termin anfragen'
Responsive layout stacks vertically at mobile widths (tested at 860px, 800px, 390px)
No console errors on German home page
Component code includes proper translations for NL and FR locales
action_item_for_main_agent: NL and FR locale pages show 'Seite nicht verfügbar' (page not available) in the preview build. This is a build/deployment configuration issue, not a component bug. The IdentityHero component code includes proper NL and FR translations. If NL/FR locale testing is required, the preview build needs to include those locale pages.

success_percentage.locale_coverage: 33% (1/3 locales available for testing - DE only, NL and FR pages not in build)
